name: Reset Week
description: Seven gentle days to get back on top of life — one theme a day, nothing over 20 minutes.

0.title: Water, meds, and a real meal check
Write tomorrow's one thing on day 2

1.title: Reply to the one message you're avoiding

2.title: Book or confirm one appointment you've been delaying

3.title: Open the bills. Just look. Looking counts.
Pay or schedule one of them

4.title: One drawer or one shelf — not the whole room

5.title: Say no to one thing this week

6.title: Restock list: what ran out this week?
You made it. Do nothing. That's the task.
